request: 멤버십 구독 안내를 크리에이터가 정한 이름으로 표시하고 가격/혜택을 floating 레이어로 제공
head: 337f1ca4b47d5e36033a2a9df85a0daaaae65355
decisions: Shared PostMembershipNotice and existing Dialog: desktop floating modal, mobile bottom sheet; no page navigation when opening.
Minimum-rank labels use the lowest qualifying current creator membership name; exact product labels never imply higher-tier access. Missing names use generic text, never a fabricated name.

Only qualifying available offers are listed; inactive/empty cases have no subscription link. Choosing a plan navigates to the existing membership page with plan preselected; does not subscribe or pay.
Live feed first page, subsequent pages and post detail merge current plans already returned in creator profiles. No new API or server change.
Studio draft preview carries current memberships even for minimum-level posts. Read-only previews disable opening.

Native Dialog focus moved outside in automated Chromium/WebKit. Explicit Tab/Shift+Tab cycle skips disabled/hidden/nested-dialog elements. Notice trigger is focused before opening for WebKit focus restoration.

serviceAdapterBrowsers.scope: Local real service model/router with intercepted API; no real account or payment changes

references.application: Reuse labelled native modal, focus static title, contain Tab/Shift+Tab, Escape/close and return focus.

boundaries: Local source only; no production deployment, DB mutation, payment/provider execution, commits, merge or push.
Real service UI/model tested with intercepted API responses; not live customer data or a real payment.
Browser engines with mobile viewports, not physical phone testing.
Existing server authorization, subscription snapshots and media access are unchanged.
